questions.question: In a college class of 100 students, 60 like Math, 45 like Physics, and 20 like both subjects. How many students like neither Math nor Physics?
questions.svgDiagram: <svg viewBox='0 0 400 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='10' width='380' height='200' rx='12' fill='#0f172a' stroke='#334155' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='110' r='70' fill='#6366f1' fill-opacity='0.25' stroke='#818cf8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='240' cy='110' r='70' fill='#ec4899' fill-opacity='0.25' stroke='#f472b6' stroke-width='3'/><text x='130' y='115' fill='#c7d2fe' font-size='16' font-weight='bold' font-family='sans-serif'>40</text><text x='190' y='115' fill='#fbcfe8' font-size='16' font-weight='bold' font-family='sans-serif'>20</text><text x='255' y='115' fill='#fbcfe8' font-size='16' font-weight='bold' font-family='sans-serif'>25</text><text x='110' y='50' fill='#818cf8' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' font-family='sans-serif'>Math (60)</text><text x='240' y='50' fill='#f472b6' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' font-family='sans-serif'>Physics (45)</text><text x='340' y='190' fill='#94a3b8' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' font-family='monospace'>Neither: 15</text><text x='30' y='35' fill='#64748b' font-size='12' font-family='monospace'>U = 100</text></svg>
questions.explanation: Using Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion: n(M ∪ P) = n(M) + n(P) - n(M ∩ P) = 60 + 45 - 20 = 85. Total students = 100. Neither = 100 - 85 = 15.
stepByStep: Students liking at least one subject n(M ∪ P) = 60 + 45 - 20 = 85.
